summary: War-day 6. South Korea +12% after -12%. Iran nuclear-concession rumor triggered 400-point last-20-min rally on Sensex expiry; Iran later denied it as an old statement. Nifty held 24,600 (38.2% Fib, budget-day low); VIX fell; FII selling 8,000cr; rupee gained 48 paise.

lessons: In war-driven markets a single headline can move the index hundreds of points in minutes; verify across global media before reacting.

leaks: workshop promos: 14-15 March Mumbai, 21-22 March Chennai, 'dinner with Pierre Sundar', charity dinner

summary: Recaps prior-day 'Iran willing to negotiate' rumor as pure manipulation (absent from Reuters/Bloomberg/CNN/CNBC). Dow fell 1,100+ then recovered. US reportedly permits India Russian crude for 1 month. GIFT -250; range view 24,000-25,400; HDFC -15%, ICICI -10%, RIL -12% in 2 months.

events.claim: US reportedly permitted India to buy Russian crude for one month (early March 2026)
HDFC Bank -15%, ICICI Bank -10%, Reliance -12% in the two months to Mar 6, 2026
Dow fell more than 1,100 points intraday then recovered (Mar 5, 2026 US session)

lessons: Do not short panic markets: one genuine ceasefire headline can reverse everything; trade defined ranges instead.

events.claim: Bank Nifty fell from ~61,500 high to below 58,000, about 8-9% in two months (by Mar 6, 2026)
HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank together contributed ~140 points of Nifty's fall on Mar 6, 2026
US nonfarm payrolls released first Friday of March 2026

lessons: Trade the price, not the narrative: fake and real headlines look identical until verified against global wires.
War weekends are binary: position sizes down, hedges on, before Friday close.

summary: Crisis morning: Brent opened ~$110 after Hormuz closure; South Korea -6%; US/EU futures -2-3%; GIFT -3%. Nifty future down ~1,200 from ~25,000 in two days. Advice: cut longs, hedge everything, or stay away; 24,000 (50% Fib) breaking; no point finding next support.

events.claim: Brent crude opened around $110/barrel on Mar 9, 2026 after the Strait of Hormuz closure
Nifty futures fell nearly 1,200 points from ~25,000 within two days (Mar 5-9, 2026)

lessons: When a supply choke drives the market, trade the impact chain - crude, autos, banks - not the war itself.
In random-violence regimes the best trade can be no trade: booking small losses beats riding un hedgeable gaps.
quote: There is no support in a bear market and no resistance in a bull market.
